ranked_evidence.title: Kalshi helped set up 2024 FBI raid of arch-rival Polymarket CEO’s apartment: report - New York Post
ranked_evidence.snippet: # Kalshi helped set up 2024 FBI raid of arch-rival Polymarket CEO’s apartment: report. Prediction market Kalshi helped tee up a November 2024 FBI raid on the apartment of its arch-rival Polymarket’s CEO – part of a series of blows the companies have traded during their yearslong feud, according to a report that cited Polymarket sources. Before the raid, Kalshi attorneys met with prosecutors in Manhattan to amplify their concerns about Polymarket’s business, the New York Times reported. Not long after, FBI agents used a battering ram to bust into Polymarket founder and CEO Shayne Coplan’s apartment before dawn on Nov. 13, 2024 — part of an investigation into whether Polymarket illegally allowed Americans to place bets on its platform. Polymarket execs speculated that someone working for Kalshi — or acting on its behalf — had tailed Coplan, spotted federal agents outside his apartment on the day of the raid and quickly tipped off journalists to get the news to spread quickly, the Times reported.

ranked_evidence.title: Inside Dani Olmo's Personal Life: Girlfriend, Parents, Siblings, Ethnicity, Family Background & More - Yahoo Sports
ranked_evidence.snippet: Dani Olmo has become one of Spain's most important attacking players thanks to his versatility, creativity, and eye for goal. Comfortable as an attacking midfielder or winger, he has been a key figure for both club and country, helping Spain win UEFA Euro 2024 and playing an important role during the nation's run to the 2026 FIFA World Cup final. Away from soccer, Olmo has kept much of his personal life out of the spotlight, although his long-term relationship has attracted public attention. He is of Spanish ethnicity and comes from a soccer-loving family that played a major role in his development. His mother, Anna Olmo, has largely stayed away from the public eye and has supported Dani throughout his career. Dani also has an older brother, Carlos Olmo, who has worked as his agent and has helped manage his professional career for several years. The close relationship between the brothers has been an important part of Olmo's rise in professional soccer.

ranked_evidence.title: Mamdani says he’s still looking into arresting Netanyahu if Israeli leader visits New York - CNN
ranked_evidence.snippet: # Mamdani says he’s still looking into arresting Netanyahu if Israeli leader visits New York. New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani said his office is still looking into arresting Benjamin Netanyahu if the Israeli prime minister visits the city for the United Nations General Assembly in September. Speaking on The New York Times’ “The Interview” podcast, Mamdani said his administration’s legal department is actively discussing the potential arrest of Netanyahu, something he vowed on the campaign trail to pursue. The ICC issued an arrest warrant for Netanyahu and other Israeli leaders in 2024, accusing them of war crimes during and after the October 7, 2023, Hamas attacks on Israel. Israel’s ambassador to the United Nations, Danny Danon, said on social media Saturday that Netanyahu “will come to New York, address the United Nations General Assembly with pride, and stand before the world to state Israel’s truth and its unwavering right to defend its citizens.”.

ranked_evidence.title: Kirandeep Kaur's family 'devastated by her death', sister says - BBC
ranked_evidence.snippet: # Kirandeep Kaur: 'The big sister who was my world'. The sister of a 24-year-old mother who was stabbed and killed as she lay in bed with her husband and baby in west London on Sunday has said "she was my world". Kirandeep Kaur, who was fatally attacked at her home in Hayes, was originally from India. Speaking through a translator, her sister Gursharan told BBC London: "She is everything for me, she video calls me and my mum. Gursharan, who is 21, said her sister came to London looking for a better job so she could support her family. "She was the top of her class here in India when she was studying, she's a very hard worker. "My sister meant the world to me, she supported me and she loved me. Gusharan added: "We are grateful to the people in London who are coming to the gatherings and vigils in London for my sister.

ranked_evidence.title: Calcutta High Court Orders Arrest of Cricketer Abishek Porel in Rape and Blackmail Case With Private Photos - Republic World
ranked_evidence.snippet: * Calcutta High Court Orders Arrest of Cricketer Abishek Porel in Rape and Blackmail Case With Private Photos. ## The Calcutta High Court has ordered the immediate arrest of Delhi Capitals cricketer Abishek Porel over rape and blackmail allegations. Abishek Porel Arrest Ordered by Calcutta High Court in Rape Case | Image: iplt20.com. In a major legal development, the Calcutta High Court has ordered the immediate arrest of Bengal and Delhi Capitals cricketer Abishek Porel. The orders come in light of serious allegations leveled by a medical student, who has accused the duo of rape, physical assault, and criminal intimidation. To protect the complainant's privacy and secure critical evidence, the Calcutta High Court has ordered the immediate seizure of electronic devices belonging to Porel and the co-accused. While Porel has previously denied the allegations, police confirmed to the court that efforts to locate and arrest the accused are currently underway.
